## Où j'en suis
Real SAML login now works on staging with Fernhill's IdP, after the short RelayState fix (commit 6d0e2b8). PR #415 (JIT provisioning) is merged. PR #421 (group-to-role mapping plus short RelayState) is open. Everyone still lands as `viewer` because Fernhill's assertion has no `groups` claim. (source: ses-sso-3, kestrel-analytics/platform#415, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)

- [en-cours] PR #421 is open: `saml_role_mapping` per tenant (`Fernhill-Kestrel-Admins` → admin, default viewer), applied on every login. Tests pass. (source: f4a91c7, kestrel-analytics/platform#421)
- [prochaine-étape] Email Fernhill IT today so they add the groups claim. (source: s3-05)
- [prochaine-étape] Once the claim exists, create an admin test account and keep `kestrel.test1` for the demo. (source: s3-08)
- [prochaine-étape] Demo with Fernhill IT on Thursday Nov 19, 10:00 New York. (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes311)
- [question] Default role: Fernhill IT's Slack message asks for `analyst` and IdP-initiated only. No `analyst` role exists, and Maya is to talk to them. (source: src-slack-fernhill, s3-07)
- [question] An agent note says SSO enforcement on Dec 1 was decided with Maya. No team source confirms it. (source: src-note-enforce)
- [essai-raté] The full return URL as RelayState (143 bytes) was rejected by Fernhill's ADFS (MSIS7042, limit 80 bytes). Fix: a 16-byte random ID stored in Redis for 600 s. (source: s3-02, 6d0e2b8)
- [décision] RelayState is a short opaque ID, with the URL stored in Redis for 10 minutes. (source: s3-03)
- [décision] `viewer` stays the default role until Maya talks to Fernhill. SP-initiated login stays on. (source: s3-07)
- [décision] Unverified domains never create a user. (source: s2-03)
